title: OnWheels: measured accessibility features in OpenStreetMap
description: Entrances, kerbs, toilets, lifts, reception desks and disabled parking in Belgium and Hauts-de-France, as mapped in OpenStreetMap with the OnWheels map (MapComplete): entrance and door widths, automatic doors, kerb heights, tactile paving, toilet door width and changing tables, lift dimensions and speech output, desk heights and disabled parking capacity, with lengths in metres. Search around a point within 300 m. Live data from OpenStreetMap; the detail of a feature says whether its last edit was made with OnWheels. A missing attribute means unknown. When OpenStreetMap's shared server is busy, calls return 503 with a retry time.
